b: Meaningful effort makes life fulfilling. The danger of prosperity and ease is boredom.
The Connection of Effort and Meaning
Meaning stands on effort. But not all sweat matters. Effort becomes meaningful when one of three things is true.
It moves you toward the person you aspire to become.
Don’t say you believe in personal development when you tolerate mediocrity.
Focus on relationships when you believe family matters. Create things if you value creativity.
Meaning emerges when values drive effort.
Life is shallow apart from struggle.
The enemy of meaning is ease. Ease is boring.
Confronting a difficult conversation is more meaningful than completing ten effortless tasks.
Don’t blindly respond to expectations. Conscious investment produces ownership.
Choose effort that expresses who you are.
#4. Effort without meaning leads to exhaustion.
More effort doesn’t necessarily mean more meaning.
People stay busy to feel important. They work harder to avoid confronting uncomfortable questions.
People don’t need easy work. They need work worth doing.
What makes your hard work worth doing?
